AmbientProps - lived-in ambient props for the night jewellery store, office and street
Prepared 2026-10-17. Not yet imported or checked in Unity (unverified).

Three sources and two licences. Per-file source URL, mirror commit and SHA-256 are in sources.json.
  1. Poly Haven models: CC0 1.0. No attribution required; credits below are a courtesy.
  2. Sketchfab models: CC BY 4.0. ATTRIBUTION IS REQUIRED wherever the demo is shared (credits screen / docs).
  3. Quaternius models (via Poly Pizza): CC0 1.0.

CC0 1.0:   https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Licence evidence, Poly Haven: CC0 per https://polyhaven.com/license (github.com/Poly-Haven/polyhaven.com public/locales/en/license.json: "Our assets are all licensed as CC0"); authors from the Poly Haven API listing (Akshay25798/VFX-Houdini-Asset_Browser downloads/json/models.json) or, for newer assets, the credits files of EliteGamer007/6dof-drone-sim and EfeAkkurt/cycase. The mirror repositories ship the unmodified 1K glTF.

Licence evidence, Sketchfab: CC BY 4.0: each GLB is a Sketchfab download whose embedded glTF asset.extras records author, license "CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)", source URL and title (checked in every file); the mirror TheMarco/liminal also records them in models/cc_by/<name>/SOURCE.md. sketchfab.com itself is not reachable from the build container.

Licence evidence, Poly Pizza (Quaternius): CC0 1.0 per bumbeishvili/green-diamond assets/models/CREDITS.md and manifest.json (author Quaternius, poly.pizza source URL); Quaternius publishes all packs as CC0. poly.pizza is not reachable from the build container.
